notes: Background music made with the ElevenLabs Music API. id -> {prompt, seconds}. Played by music(id) in core.js; tracks loop with a crossfade, so avoid big endings on looping tracks. Run: node --env-file=.env tools/make-music.mjs
style: 8-bit chiptune, NES / Game Boy style square and triangle waves, kids video game, instrumental, no vocals

title.prompt: Cheerful catchy title-screen theme, bouncy melody, medium tempo, invites you to press start, seamless loop, no ending

drive.prompt: Upbeat bouncy driving music for a co-op smash-everything game, playful bassline, steady snappy drums, happy and energetic but not frantic, seamless loop, no intro and no ending

boss.prompt: Goofy epic boss battle music, fast and dramatic but silly and fun, never scary, driving arpeggios and big drums, seamless loop, no ending

victory.prompt: Triumphant victory fanfare, bright and happy, ends on a big final chord

candy_drive.prompt: Sweet sugar-rush driving tune like cruising through a candy shop: bouncy bubbly bassline, twinkly music-box and glockenspiel lead, skippy happy groove, seamless loop, no intro and no ending

candy_boss.prompt: Goofy giant-dessert boss showdown, fast and dramatic but silly, never scary: oompah tuba bass, wobbly jelly synth, a chorus of kazoos, sparkly runs, seamless loop, no ending

dino_drive.prompt: Happy jungle stomp like a cartoon dinosaur parade: tribal toy drums and log marimba, bouncy tuba walking bassline, whistled ocarina lead, the odd goofy honk on the beat, seamless loop, no intro and no ending

dino_boss.prompt: Clumsy giant dinosaur boss showdown, silly never scary: big boomy timpani stomps, a low brass riff that trips over itself, rumbling volcano bass, slide whistle and kazoo stabs, rising excitement, seamless loop, no ending

bedroom_drive.prompt: Cozy playful toy-box driving tune, a bedroom full of toys come to life: music-box and toy-piano melody over a bouncy ukulele and glockenspiel groove, light toy drums, cheeky kazoo hooks, upbeat and happy, seamless loop, no intro and no ending

bedroom_boss.prompt: Goofy toy-soldier boss march, a lullaby turned into a showdown: music box and toy xylophone runs over a bouncy oompah tuba beat, marching toy drums, tin trumpets, wind-up whirs, big and silly, never scary, seamless loop, no ending
